mutations.name: a missing TEST ONLY key is a ResealError
mutations.old: raise ResealError(f"{where}: no TEST ONLY key for {fingerprint}") from None

mutations.name: registry entry keys go through signing_key
signed YAML keys go through signing_key
gate record keys go through signing_key
mutations.old: signing_key(by_fp, a["key_fingerprint"], d.name)) for a in required_signers

mutations.name: feedback and withdrawal keys go through signing_key
mutations.old: signing_key(by_fp, x["key_fingerprint"], d.name)) for x in required_signers
